text:
alex_support: opening a rush repro checklist — seeing 5xx/timeouts from hosted inference in us-west + eu-central. Customers reported timeouts and duplicate billing events. 5xx rate ~15% over last 10m, spike started ~12:12 UTC. using this thread for triage, mitigation, and customer comms.

maya_ops: grabbing gateway + ingress logs now, streaming p99/p95. will check kube events and autoscaler churn.

jordan_sre: looking at gateway pods — seeing 502/504s correlate with autoscaler flapping and backend auth upstream errors. adding trace ids to the logs.

alex_support: runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/inference-5xx (internal). quick repro we got from customer: ```curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"long prompt..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate``` response: 504 after 10s consistently for certain request shapes.

sam_dev: I shipped a routing tweak ~30m before spike to change model routing logic for burst mitigation. rolling a canary rollback now to v1 routing.

deploy-bot: rollback to gateway-v1 canary started (canary group 1/4).

deploy-bot: rollback successful on 3/4 canaries; full rollback queued, monitoring error rate.

jordan_sre: seeing auth refresh failing under load — auth-service returning upstream 502s. stack snippet: ```AuthError: upstream 502: read timeout\n at auth/refresh.go:73``` possible root: token refresh storm when clients retry aggressively.

lina_cs: Customer A flagged duplicate billing charges due to client retries. Escalating to billing team, need charge snapshot + request ids. I can draft the customer comms once we have a timeline.

maya_ops: hot mitigation: increasing gateway connection timeout to 30s and enabling circuit breaker for known heavy clients. applying patch to ingress config now (short patch, no deploy).

sam_dev: pushed heuristic to avoid large KV-cache invalidations on prefix-heavy requests (canary). should reduce backend pressure if curl repro matches.

alex_support: immediate action items: 1) finish rollback and confirm 5xx drops (owner: sam_dev) 2) collect request ids and full traces for affected customers (owner: maya_ops) 3) billing charge snapshot + hold refunds / investigation (owner: lina_cs) 4) postmortem + RCA doc (owner: jordan_sre) 5) customer comms draft & legal review (owner: lina_cs). Anyone volunteer to own a reproducible test harness?

jordan_sre: I'll own the postmortem and repro harness. ETA: initial RCA + repro steps in 24h, full postmortem in 72h.

maya_ops: logs archived to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/1729005432/, full bucket contains gateway, auth, and kv-cache traces. link: https://s3/internal/1729005432 (internal).

lina_cs: drafted customer note, sending to legal + trust for review, ETA ~3h. will include timeline and mitigation steps.

oncall-bot: Incident declared severity 2 — paged oncall and owners.

alex_support: thanks folks — once rollback confirm drops, lock down followups in the incident tracker (board and checklist). reconvene in 30m or sooner if error rate remains >5%.

(annotations: used short snippets and internal links. keep further chatter to this thread to preserve audit trail.)
